lemma_assessments.finding: Keeping U fixed while enlarging the ambient square preserves every old graph-edge relevance witness. Any graph edge incident with a fresh row or column has at least one empty complement star, and a semi-filter cannot contain the empty set, so it creates no new relevance witness.
lemma_assessments.seed_application: The fourth row and fourth column are empty U-stars, so the 3x3 and 4x4 seed relevance families agree. The recorded feasible cover and feasible packing have equal value 3/2, which certifies the registered seed optimum within the complete pair model.

lemma_assessments.finding: For an old witness edge (r,c), it is enough that this old graph edge remains and that the child r-row and c-column stars restrict to their parent stars. Cylinder membership then equals parent membership. If a cylinder lift fails to preserve a child full-union pair, its projections cover the parent ground set and must be incomparable, so parent pair-load feasibility bounds the lifted load.
lemma_assessments.wording_defect: The phrase 'every child row/column star restricts to its parent star' is undefined for fresh vertices and is stronger than needed. State the hypothesis only for old-coordinate stars at retained old witness edges.
lemma_assessments.registered_instance: The one-sided rule leaves the old-old block unchanged, and the receipt directly exhibits relevance witnesses for all three positive parent supports and maximum lifted load 1.

lemma_assessments.np_hardness_assessment: The proposed reduction has the correct polarity: a canonical formula word x=x_L||x_R maps to the old-new query (0||x_L,1||x_R), which is a graph edge exactly when Dec(x) is satisfiable. Its output length is |x|+2, conditional on a fixed polynomial-time standard-to-canonical 3CNF encoding.
lemma_assessments.np_membership_defect: The displayed verifier relation is not polynomially balanced. The decoder permits a declared variable count v exponentially larger than the word length, while assignment_satisfies requires a tuple of length exactly v.
lemma_assessments.exact_counterfamily: Let v=2^t, m=1, and use the clause (x1 OR x1 OR x1). Its valid magic encoding has length 5t+16 plus at most one parity bit, but the displayed witness has length v=2^t. The displayed exhaustive search also examines 2^v assignments, so it is not the claimed 2^{O(n)} procedure on these inputs.
lemma_assessments.repair_obligation: Define a sparse certificate only on variables that actually occur, and search only the at most three-times-clause-count occurring variables. Then prove polynomial balance and verification through the old-old recursion, and separately prove 2^{O(n)} deterministic membership using the occurring-variable support. Until this is frozen and reviewed, NP-completeness remains proposal-only rather than established.

lp_polarity_audit.original_orientation: The graph-cover primal minimizes weight on legal pairs; its packing dual maximizes weight on relevant semi-filters subject to every pair load being at most 1.
lp_polarity_audit.residual_orientation: The gate fixes the lifted filter-packing vector y_up and maximizes an additional nonnegative filter vector z under capacities c_p=1-load_p(y_up). The residual covering dual puts nonnegative weights lambda_p on pairs, covers each child-relevant semi-filter to weight at least 1, and minimizes sum_p c_p lambda_p.
lp_polarity_audit.direct_zero_certificate: The pairs (3,28) and (5,26) both have c_p=0. Every possible nonempty row-star/column-star graph witness listed in this review forces an upward-closed semi-filter to contain both sides of at least one of these two disjoint pairs. Thus weights 1 and 1 on the two residual covering-dual coordinates cover every relevant semi-filter at objective 0. Since z=0 is packing-feasible, the residual optimum is exactly 0.
lp_polarity_audit.terminology_warning: The seed section calls the pair-cover program primal, while the residual section calls the filter-packing program primal. The mathematics is consistent, but future artifacts should name variables and min/max directions explicitly to avoid a false polarity swap.

mathematical_lessons_retained: Empty-star ambient enlargement preserves relevance because no semi-filter contains the empty set.
Retained old witnesses plus exact star restriction preserve cylinder relevance; pair projection then preserves supported packing feasibility.
Feasible inherited mass can saturate a tiny pair cover of the entire new relevance class, leaving zero coordinatewise additive capacity.
Zero residual augmentation at a fixed packing is strictly weaker than equality of reoptimized optima.

A succinctly declared variable universe can make a naive full assignment exponentially longer than the formula word; NP witnesses must be polynomially balanced, normally by restricting to occurring variables.
